question: Let $AB$ be a fixed line segment. Let $P$ be a moving point such that $\angle APB$ is equal to a constant acute angle. Then, which of the following curves does the point $P$ move along?

options.C: the boundary of the common region of 2 identical intersecting circles with centres outside the common region;
options.D: the boundary of the union of 2 identical intersecting circles with centres outside the common region.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
